paragraphs: Ovarro builds monitoring, control and data technology for organizations managing critical assets across water, oil and gas, broadcast, process, energy and transportation. The hardware range runs to remote telemetry units, acoustic microphones, data loggers, leak noise loggers, correlators and flow meters.

SCOPE, the company's enterprise SCADA and telemetry system, monitors and controls a diverse range of assets in real time. Analytics products named BurstDetect, BlockageDetect and PumpInsight watch pumps and work to prevent sewer bursts and blockages. Consultancy sits alongside the products, with technical directors and analysts specialising in asset management, leakage and demand, and network optimisation.

Published case studies lean heavily on water utilities, among them LeakNavigator work described as saving millions of litres for Thames Water. Another describes a SCADA deployment enabling real-time monitoring of more than 2,000 assets, with gains in efficiency, leakage detection and planning. The company reports more than 250 experienced colleagues and over 70 certified channel partners around the world. It dates its origins to industrial automation for the steel industry in the North of England forty years ago.

quote.text: At Ovarro, we connect big data to make a big difference.
